name: prompt-engineering-exam-assistant
title_zh: 截图即解规则型 Prompt 题
tagline_zh: 对着屏幕拍张照，或粘一段文字，它帮你拆解规则、算清分类，直接产出格式严丝合缝的 JSON 答案——不再手抖漏字段。
tagline_en: Snap a pic or paste text—it dissects rules, computes classifications, and outputs perfectly formatted JSON. No.
desc_en: Solve rule-based Prompt engineering exercises from screenshots or text when the required final answer is structured JSON. Use when the user asks to create, revise, or debug a calculation or classification Prompt with exact output formatting.
why_zh: 它把「规则→推理→JSON」整条链路焊死，每一步都校验格式，专治那种算对了却因少个引号被拒的憋屈。
why_en: It welds the whole chain from rules to reasoning to JSON, validating format at every step—cures the sting of being right but.
limit_zh: 只认规则明确、答案需结构化 JSON 的题；自由发挥的开放题它不接。截图要清晰，文字要完整，否则它只会让你重发。
limit_en: Only handles rule-based exercises requiring structured JSON output; open-ended prompts are out. Needs clear screenshots or full text, else it asks.
title_en: Solve rule-based prompt exercises from screenshots to JSON
